ex.en: I did my homework after I took a nap.
ex.zh: 我小睡一下之後才寫作業。

ex.en: The moment she'd finished, she lay down for a nap.
ex.zh: 她一做完就躺下來小睡一下。

ex.en: What's more, Chinese people like taking naps.
ex.zh: 此外，中國人喜歡睡午覺。

nap.en: a short sleep, usually during the day

ex.en: While napping, I had a strange dream.
ex.zh: 我在小睡時做了個奇怪的夢。

ex.en: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
ex.zh: 我可能很快就會放棄，乾脆去睡一下。

nap.en: to sleep for a short time, usually during the day

ex.en: A nail penetrated the car tyre.
ex.zh: 車胎被釘子刺破了。

ex.en: He hammered a nail into the wall.
ex.zh: 他把一根釘子敲進牆裡。

nail.en: a thin pointed piece of metal hit with a hammer to join things

ex.en: She has a habit of biting her nails.
ex.zh: 她有咬指甲的習慣。

ex.en: Have you noticed any changes in your hair or nails?
ex.zh: 你有注意到頭髮或指甲有什麼變化嗎？

nail.en: the hard thin layer that covers the end of a finger or toe

ex.en: He nailed the sign to the door.
ex.zh: 他把告示牌釘在門上。

ex.en: Nail the boards together first.
ex.zh: 先把木板釘在一起。

nail.en: to fix something in place with thin pointed pieces of metal

ex.en: Ya-wen nailed her proposal yesterday. The boss kept nodding.
ex.zh: 雅雯昨天的提案做得超好，主管一直點頭。

ex.en: You totally nailed the interview!
ex.zh: 你的面試表現超棒！

nail.en: to do something very well or succeed at it

ex.en: The company launched a nationwide campaign.
ex.zh: 公司推出了一項全國性的行銷活動。

ex.en: There was a nationwide survey on working hours.
ex.zh: 有一項關於工時的全國性調查。

nationwide.en: happening in every part of a country

ex.en: The product will be available nationwide next month.
ex.zh: 這項產品下個月將在全國上市。

ex.en: We have over 50 stores nationwide.
ex.zh: 我們在全國有超過五十家門市。

nationwide.en: in every part of a country

ex.en: I'm not a nationalist, I'm a patriot.
ex.zh: 我不是民族主義者，我是愛國者。

ex.en: The writer was a nationalist who loved his country's culture.
ex.zh: 這位作家是民族主義者，熱愛自己國家的文化。

nationalist.en: a person who strongly loves their own country and wants it to be independent

nasty.zh: 令人不快的、惡劣的；惡意的

ex.en: She gives me a nasty look every time she sees me.
ex.zh: 她每次看到我都狠狠瞪我一眼。

ex.en: There's a nasty smell in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡有一股難聞的味道。

ex.en: Regardless how many times I try to solve this nasty problem, I always end up failing.
ex.zh: 這個棘手的問題我不管試幾次，最後都失敗。

ex.en: She had a nasty fall on the stairs.
ex.zh: 她在樓梯上重重摔了一跤。

nasty.en: serious and difficult to deal with

ex.en: Two people were absent, namely Tom and Amy.
ex.zh: 有兩個人缺席，也就是湯姆和 Amy。

ex.en: We face one big problem, namely a lack of time.
ex.zh: 我們面臨一個大問題，那就是時間不夠。

namely.en: used to introduce the exact details of what you just mentioned

ex.en: The government decided to nationalize the railways.
ex.zh: 政府決定把鐵路收歸國有。

ex.en: The oil industry was nationalized in the 1970s.
ex.zh: 石油產業在一九七〇年代被收歸國有。

nationalize.en: to put a business under the control of the government

ex.en: Sports events often bring out a sense of nationalism.
ex.zh: 體育賽事常常激發民族主義情緒。

ex.en: The book explores the rise of nationalism in Europe.
ex.zh: 這本書探討歐洲民族主義的興起。

nationalism.en: strong pride in your own country and its people

ex.en: Delete his name from the list of the applicants.
ex.zh: 把他的名字從申請者名單中刪除。

ex.en: We ought to sort the students' names alphabetically.
ex.zh: 我們應該把學生的名字按字母順序排列。

ex.en: What's your name?
ex.zh: 你叫什麼名字？

name.en: the word or words that a person or thing is called

ex.en: The young man I met yesterday is named Tony.
ex.zh: 我昨天遇到的那個年輕人叫東尼。

ex.en: I don't know who named this dog Pochi.
ex.zh: 我不知道是誰把這隻狗取名叫波奇。

name.en: to give a person or thing a particular word to be called

ex.en: She was named CEO last month.
ex.zh: 她上個月被任命為執行長。

ex.en: He was named employee of the year.
ex.zh: 他獲選為年度最佳員工。

name.en: to choose someone officially for a job or role

ex.en: Some national parks offer showers and even baby-sitting services.
ex.zh: 有些國家公園提供淋浴設施，甚至還有托嬰服務。

ex.en: He's a professor at the National University.
ex.zh: 他是國立大學的教授。

ex.en: The news was reported on national television.
ex.zh: 這則新聞在全國性電視台播出。

national.en: relating to a whole country, not just one part of it

ex.en: Foreign nationals need a visa to enter.
ex.zh: 外國人入境需要簽證。

ex.en: She is a Japanese national.
ex.zh: 她是日本國民。

national.en: a person who belongs to a particular country

ex.en: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
ex.zh: 我們必須學會與自然和諧相處。

ex.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.
ex.zh: 大自然在我們生活中扮演重要角色。

ex.en: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.
ex.zh: 彩虹是大自然最美的現象之一。

nature.en: all the plants, animals, and things in the world not made by people

ex.en: The nature of my job requires a lot of travel.
ex.zh: 我的工作性質需要經常出差。

ex.en: Can you explain the nature of the problem?
ex.zh: 你能說明這個問題的本質嗎？

nature.en: the basic qualities or character of something

ex.en: It's human nature to want to be liked.
ex.zh: 希望被人喜歡是人的天性。

ex.en: She is kind by nature.
ex.zh: 她天性善良。

nature.en: the basic character of a person or living thing

ex.en: There are more than 150 nations in the world.
ex.zh: 世界上有超過一百五十個國家。

ex.en: The two nations have strong trade ties.
ex.zh: 這兩國有密切的貿易關係。

ex.en: Every nation, rich or poor, has its strengths and weaknesses.
ex.zh: 每個國家，無論貧富，都有其長處與短處。

nation.en: a country with its own government and people

ex.en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.
ex.zh: 總統在電視上對全國人民發表談話。

ex.en: The whole nation watched the game.
ex.zh: 全國人民都在看那場比賽。

nation.en: all the people who live in a country

ex.en: Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.
ex.zh: 水、森林和礦物都是重要的天然資源。

ex.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
ex.zh: 美國的天然資源很豐富。

ex.en: This juice is made with natural ingredients.
ex.zh: 這款果汁使用天然原料製成。

natural.en: found in the world and not made by people

natural.zh: 自然的、正常的、不做作的

ex.en: I think the sentence would sound more natural like that.
ex.zh: 我覺得這樣寫句子聽起來比較自然。

ex.en: It's natural to feel nervous before an interview.
ex.zh: 面試前會緊張是很正常的。

natural.en: normal and as you would expect, not forced

ex.en: This road is too narrow for cars to pass.
ex.zh: 這條路太窄，車子過不去。

ex.en: The man is hiking on a narrow path.
ex.zh: 那個男人在一條狹窄的小路上健行。

narrow.en: small in width from one side to the other

ex.en: We won by a narrow margin.
ex.zh: 我們以些微差距獲勝。

ex.en: He had a narrow escape from the fire.
ex.zh: 他從火場中驚險逃生。

narrow.en: only just achieved, with very little difference

narrow.zh: 縮小、變窄（narrow down 縮小範圍）

ex.en: The gap between them has narrowed.
ex.zh: 他們之間的差距縮小了。

ex.en: We've narrowed down the list to three candidates.
ex.zh: 我們已把名單縮小到三位候選人。

narrow.en: to become smaller in width or amount

ex.en: He has a very narrow view of the world.
ex.zh: 他的世界觀非常狹隘。

ex.en: Her definition of success is too narrow.
ex.zh: 她對成功的定義太狹隘了。

narrow.en: limited and not open to new ideas

native.zh: 母語的；本國的、出生地的

ex.en: She is a native speaker of French.
ex.zh: 她的母語是法語。

ex.en: This book is for students whose native language is not Japanese.
ex.zh: 這本書是給母語不是日語的學生用的。

ex.en: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.
ex.zh: 我跟一位英語母語人士學了四年英語。

native.en: relating to the place or language you were born with

native.zh: 本地人、在某地出生的人

ex.en: I can speak Esperanto like a native.
ex.zh: 我說世界語可以說得跟母語人士一樣。

ex.en: She is a native of Taipei.
ex.zh: 她是土生土長的台北人。

native.en: a person who was born in a particular place

native.zh: （動植物）原生的、原產於某地的

ex.en: This plant is native to Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這種植物原產於台灣。

ex.en: Native species are being replaced by foreign ones.
ex.zh: 原生物種正逐漸被外來種取代。

native.en: growing or living naturally in a place and not brought from elsewhere

ex.en: She naturally accepted the invitation.
ex.zh: 她理所當然地接受了邀請。

ex.en: With so many people around he naturally became a bit nervous.
ex.zh: 身邊圍了那麼多人，他自然有點緊張。

naturally.en: as you would expect, or of course

ex.en: She is naturally shy.
ex.zh: 她天生害羞。

ex.en: My hair is naturally curly.
ex.zh: 我的頭髮是自然捲。

naturally.en: in a way that you were born with

ex.en: Just act naturally in front of the camera.
ex.zh: 在鏡頭前自然一點就好。

ex.en: Try to speak naturally during the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時盡量自然地說話。

naturally.en: in a relaxed way that is not forced

ex.en: The book is a narrative of his life in Africa.
ex.zh: 這本書敘述他在非洲的生活。

ex.en: The film has a simple narrative.
ex.zh: 這部電影的劇情很簡單。

narrative.en: a spoken or written account of events

narrative.zh: 論述、說法（官方或媒體的）

ex.en: The company wants to change the narrative about its products.
ex.zh: 公司想改變外界對它產品的說法。

ex.en: The media created a false narrative.
ex.zh: 媒體塑造了不實的論述。

narrative.en: a particular way of explaining events or ideas

ex.en: The boy was naked to the waist.
ex.zh: 那個男孩打著赤膊。

ex.en: Tom is naked from the waist up.
ex.zh: 湯姆打著赤膊。

ex.en: My little brother ran through the living room stark naked.
ex.zh: 我弟弟光著身子跑過客廳。

ex.en: You can see it with the naked eye.
ex.zh: 用肉眼就看得到。

ex.en: That star is visible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 那顆星星用肉眼就看得到。

ex.en: It is visible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 它肉眼可見。

naked.en: the eye used without any help from tools such as glasses

ex.en: I feel a little nauseous, but I'm unable to throw up.
ex.zh: 有點噁心，但是吐不出來。

ex.en: Do you feel nauseous?
ex.zh: 你會想吐嗎？

nauseous.en: feeling that you are going to be sick

ex.en: The naval base is located on the east coast.
ex.zh: 海軍基地位在東海岸。

ex.en: He served as a naval officer for ten years.
ex.zh: 他當了十年的海軍軍官。

naval.en: relating to a country's navy or its ships

ex.en: They had nausea.
ex.zh: 他們感到噁心想吐。

ex.en: This medicine may cause nausea and dizziness.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能會引起噁心和頭暈。

ex.en: Many pregnant women suffer from nausea in the morning.
ex.zh: 許多孕婦早上會感到噁心想吐。

nausea.en: the feeling that you are going to be sick

ex.en: I don't mean to nag you.
ex.zh: 我並不想嘮叨你。

ex.en: Mike is always nagging his father to buy him a car.
ex.zh: 麥克老是纏著爸爸要他買車。

ex.en: My mom keeps nagging me to clean my room.
ex.zh: 我媽一直嘮叨要我打掃房間。

nag.en: to keep asking or complaining in an annoying way

ex.en: She folded the napkin and placed it beside the plate.
ex.zh: 她摺好餐巾，放在盤子旁邊。

ex.en: Could we have an extra napkin for the table?
ex.zh: 可以再給我們一張餐巾紙嗎？

napkin.en: a piece of cloth or paper used to clean your mouth and hands at meals

ex.en: What nationality is Tom?
ex.zh: 湯姆是哪國人？

ex.en: That company hires people without regard to race, religion, or nationality.
ex.zh: 這家公司雇人不分種族、宗教或國籍。

ex.en: Everyone has the right to a nationality.
ex.zh: 人人都有取得國籍的權利。

nationality.en: the fact of belonging to a particular country

ex.en: His father served in the navy for twenty years.
ex.zh: 他父親在海軍服役了二十年。

ex.en: The navy sent two ships to help after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後，海軍派了兩艘船前來協助。

ex.en: He wore a navy jacket and white pants.
ex.zh: 他穿著深藍色外套和白褲子。

ex.en: Navy is a safe color for a business suit.
ex.zh: 深藍色是商務西裝的安全選擇。

ex.en: The narrator of the story is a young girl.
ex.zh: 這個故事的敘述者是一位年輕女孩。

ex.en: The documentary has a calm narrator with a deep voice.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片的旁白聲音低沉、語調平穩。

ex.en: NATO was founded in 1949.
ex.zh: 北約成立於1949年。

ex.en: Several countries in Europe are members of NATO.
ex.zh: 歐洲有好幾個國家是北約成員。

ex.en: The show is broadcast nationally every Friday night.
ex.zh: 這個節目每週五晚上在全國播出。

ex.en: Prices have risen nationally over the past year.
ex.zh: 過去一年全國的物價都上漲了。

ex.en: The singer is nationally known, but not abroad.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在全國有名，但在國外就沒沒無聞。

ex.en: It was naive of me to believe everything he said.
ex.zh: 我太天真了，竟然相信他說的每一句話。

ex.en: The young teacher was naive about how hard the job would be.
ex.zh: 那位年輕老師太天真，不曉得這份工作有多辛苦。

ex.en: She has a naive view of how money works.
ex.zh: 她對金錢如何運作的看法很天真。

ex.en: I use my phone to navigate in a new city.
ex.zh: 我在陌生的城市用手機導航。

ex.en: It was easy to navigate with such a clear map.
ex.zh: 有這麼清楚的地圖，找路很容易。

ex.en: The website is simple to navigate.
ex.zh: 這個網站很容易瀏覽操作。

ex.en: Older users sometimes struggle to navigate new apps.
ex.zh: 年紀較大的使用者有時難以操作新的應用程式。

ex.en: She learned to navigate difficult conversations at work.
ex.zh: 她學會在職場上應對棘手的談話。

ex.en: The family navigated the crisis together.
ex.zh: 這一家人一起度過了危機。

ex.en: Napoleon was a French military leader who became emperor of France.
ex.zh: 拿破崙是法國的軍事領袖，後來成為法國皇帝。

ex.en: We read about Napoleon in our European history class.
ex.zh: 我們在歐洲史課上讀到了拿破崙。

ex.en: The driver narrowly avoided hitting the child on the road.
ex.zh: 司機險些撞到馬路上的小孩。

ex.en: Our team narrowly won the game by one point.
ex.zh: 我們隊以一分之差險勝這場比賽。

ex.en: Don't define success too narrowly; it means different things to different people.
ex.zh: 不要把成功定義得太狹隘，它對不同的人有不同的意義。

ex.en: The rule was narrowly written, so it only applies to new students.
ex.zh: 這條規定的範圍訂得很窄，所以只適用於新生。

ex.en: The car has a built-in navigation system.
ex.zh: 這輛車有內建導航系統。

ex.en: Good navigation kept us from getting lost in the forest.
ex.zh: 良好的導航讓我們沒在森林裡迷路。

ex.en: Navigation on the river is difficult during the dry season.
ex.zh: 旱季時，這條河上的航行很困難。

ex.en: Ancient sailors used the stars for navigation at sea.
ex.zh: 古代水手靠星星在海上航行。

ex.en: The naughty puppy chewed up my slippers.
ex.zh: 那隻頑皮的小狗把我的拖鞋咬爛了。

ex.en: Don't be naughty, or you won't get any dessert.
ex.zh: 別調皮，不然就沒有甜點吃。

ex.en: The family hired a nanny to look after their twin babies.
ex.zh: 那家人請了一位保姆照顧他們的雙胞胎寶寶。

ex.en: The nanny takes the children to the park every afternoon.
ex.zh: 保姆每天下午帶孩子們去公園。

ex.en: The farmer milked the nanny every morning.
ex.zh: 農夫每天早上擠母山羊的奶。

ex.en: A nanny and her kid were eating grass by the fence.
ex.zh: 一隻母山羊和牠的小羊在籬笆邊吃草。

navajo.zh: 納瓦霍人（美國原住民族）

ex.en: The Navajo are one of the largest Native American nations in the United States.
ex.zh: 納瓦霍人是美國最大的原住民族之一。

ex.en: The Navajo Nation covers parts of Arizona, New Mexico and Utah.
ex.zh: 納瓦霍族保留地橫跨亞利桑那、新墨西哥與猶他三州的部分地區。

ex.en: I have a nasal spray for my stuffy nose.
ex.zh: 我有一瓶鼻噴劑可以治鼻塞。

ex.en: He spoke in a high, nasal voice.
ex.zh: 他用尖尖的鼻音說話。

ex.en: The letter m is a nasal in English.
ex.zh: 字母 m 在英語中是鼻音。

ex.en: French has several nasal sounds that learners find hard.
ex.zh: 法語有好幾個學習者覺得很難的鼻音。

ex.en: The doctor gave him a narcotic to ease the pain.
ex.zh: 醫生給他一種麻醉藥以緩解疼痛。

ex.en: Police seized a large amount of narcotics at the port.
ex.zh: 警方在港口查獲大量毒品。

ex.en: The plant has a narcotic effect on the body.
ex.zh: 這種植物對身體有麻醉作用。

ex.en: Narcotic drugs must be handled carefully.
ex.zh: 麻醉類藥物必須小心處理。

ex.en: I visit my nan every Sunday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我每個週日下午都會去看奶奶。

ex.en: My nan makes the best apple pie.
ex.zh: 我奶奶做的蘋果派最好吃。

ex.en: We ordered curry and warm nan at the Indian restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們在那家印度餐廳點了咖哩和熱呼呼的烤餅。

ex.en: She dipped a piece of nan into the sauce.
ex.zh: 她把一塊烤餅沾進醬汁裡。

ex.en: Rows of wooden benches filled the nave of the church.
ex.zh: 教堂的中殿擺滿了一排排木長椅。

ex.en: Sunlight came through the windows into the long nave.
ex.zh: 陽光從窗戶照進長長的中殿。

ex.en: I met a woman named Linda at the bus stop.
ex.zh: 我在公車站遇到一位名叫琳達的女士。

ex.en: They adopted a puppy named Biscuit.
ex.zh: 他們領養了一隻名叫餅乾的小狗。

named.zh: 命名、提名（name 的過去式）

ex.en: They named their baby after her grandmother.
ex.zh: 他們用她祖母的名字替寶寶取名。

ex.en: The company named her the new manager last week.
ex.zh: 公司上週任命她為新經理。

ex.en: The baby needs a clean nappy right now.
ex.zh: 寶寶現在需要換一片乾淨的尿布。

ex.en: She packed nappies, a bottle, and a blanket in the bag.
ex.zh: 她在包包裡裝了尿布、奶瓶和毯子。

ex.en: The old man likes to narrate stories about his youth.
ex.zh: 老先生喜歡講述他年輕時的故事。

ex.en: A famous actor will narrate the documentary.
ex.zh: 一位知名演員將為這部紀錄片擔任旁白。

ex.en: The naturalist spent years studying birds in the forest.
ex.zh: 那位博物學家花了多年時間研究森林裡的鳥類。

ex.en: A local naturalist led our walk through the wetlands.
ex.zh: 一位當地的自然研究者帶領我們走過濕地。

ex.en: The film's narration is read by a famous actor.
ex.zh: 這部電影的旁白由一位知名演員朗讀。

ex.en: Good narration makes a story more exciting to read.
ex.zh: 好的敘述能讓故事讀起來更精彩。

namibia.zh: 納米比亞（非洲西南部國家）

ex.en: Namibia is a country in southwestern Africa.
ex.zh: 納米比亞是非洲西南部的一個國家。

ex.en: The Namib Desert gave Namibia its name.
ex.zh: 納米比沙漠是納米比亞名稱的由來。

ex.en: Naples is a city in southern Italy.
ex.zh: 那不勒斯是義大利南部的一座城市。

ex.en: Pizza is said to have been born in Naples.
ex.zh: 據說披薩起源於那不勒斯。

ex.en: The navigator checked the map and told the pilot to turn left.
ex.zh: 領航員看了地圖，告訴機師向左轉。

ex.en: Early navigators used the stars to cross the ocean.
ex.zh: 早期的航海家靠星星橫渡大洋。

ex.en: I'm tired of her nagging voice reminding me about chores.
ex.zh: 我受夠了她那嘮嘮叨叨提醒我做家事的聲音。

ex.en: A nagging parent can make a teenager want to rebel.
ex.zh: 愛嘮叨的父母可能讓青少年想反抗。

nagging.zh: 揮之不去的、持續困擾的

ex.en: I have a nagging pain in my back.
ex.zh: 我背部一直有種揮之不去的痛。

ex.en: A nagging doubt kept him awake all night.
ex.zh: 一個揮之不去的疑慮讓他整晚睡不著。

ex.en: NASA has sent robotic rovers to Mars.
ex.zh: 美國太空總署已經把機器人探測車送上火星。

ex.en: My brother dreams of working at NASA one day.
ex.zh: 我哥哥夢想有一天能在美國太空總署工作。

ex.en: The government announced the nationalisation of the railways.
ex.zh: 政府宣布鐵路國有化。

ex.en: Nationalisation of the industry was a hot debate.
ex.zh: 這個產業的國有化是熱門的辯論議題。

ex.en: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.
ex.zh: 奈洛比是肯亞的首都。

ex.en: Many safari trips start from Nairobi.
ex.zh: 許多野生動物旅遊行程都從奈洛比出發。

ex.en: "Do you want to come along?" "Nah, I'm too tired."
ex.zh: 「你要一起來嗎？」「不了，我太累了。」

ex.en: Nah, I don't think that's a good idea.
ex.zh: 不要啦，我覺得這不是個好主意。

ex.en: The nascent industry needs support to grow.
ex.zh: 這個剛萌芽的產業需要支持才能成長。

ex.en: They are building a nascent friendship after years of silence.
ex.zh: 沉默多年後，他們正在建立一段剛萌芽的友誼。

ex.en: The railway became a nationalized industry after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後鐵路成為國有化的產業。

ex.en: Many nationalized companies were later sold to private owners.
ex.zh: 許多國有化的公司後來賣給了民間業者。

ex.en: The naming of the new baby took the family a whole week.
ex.zh: 為新生寶寶命名花了全家人一整個星期。

ex.en: Naming a product well can help it sell.
ex.zh: 幫產品取個好名字有助於銷售。

ex.en: He is the namesake of his grandfather.
ex.zh: 他和祖父同名。

ex.en: The street is named after a poet, and the cafe is its namesake.
ex.zh: 這條街以一位詩人命名，那間咖啡館也以同一個名字命名。

ex.en: The baby's navel healed quickly after birth.
ex.zh: 寶寶的肚臍在出生後很快就癒合了。

ex.en: He got a small piercing in his navel.
ex.zh: 他在肚臍上穿了一個小洞。

ex.en: A nameless traveler knocked on the door late at night.
ex.zh: 一位無名的旅人在深夜敲了門。

ex.en: The donor wished to remain nameless.
ex.zh: 捐款人希望保持匿名。

nationalistic.zh: 民族主義的；國家主義的

ex.en: The speech was full of nationalistic language.
ex.zh: 這場演說充滿民族主義的言詞。

ex.en: Some of the fans became nationalistic during the match.
ex.zh: 有些球迷在比賽中變得很民族主義。

nay.zh: 不；甚至可說（用於更強烈的說法）

ex.en: It was a good idea, nay, a brilliant one.
ex.zh: 那是個好主意，不，應該說是個絕妙的主意。

ex.en: The task is difficult, nay, almost impossible.
ex.zh: 這項任務很困難，不，甚至幾乎不可能。

ex.en: The vote was seven yeas and three nays.
ex.zh: 投票結果是七票贊成、三票反對。

ex.en: Each nay was recorded by the clerk.
ex.zh: 每一張反對票都由書記記錄下來。

ex.en: The painter used a naturalistic style, so the trees look real.
ex.zh: 畫家用寫實的自然風格，所以樹看起來很真實。

ex.en: The actor gave a naturalistic performance.
ex.zh: 那位演員的表演自然而不做作。

napoleonic.zh: 拿破崙的；拿破崙時代的

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of Napoleonic weapons.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了大量拿破崙時代的武器。

ex.en: She is writing a paper about the Napoleonic wars.
ex.zh: 她正在寫一篇關於拿破崙戰爭的報告。

ex.en: The police managed to nab the thief at the train station.
ex.zh: 警方在火車站逮到了那名小偷。

ex.en: I nabbed the last seat on the bus just in time.
ex.zh: 我及時搶到公車上的最後一個座位。

ex.en: Nanotechnology works with extremely tiny materials.
ex.zh: 奈米技術處理的是極微小的材料。

ex.en: She is studying nanotechnology to design better medicines.
ex.zh: 她正在研究奈米技術以設計更好的藥物。

ex.en: He collected old nautical maps.
ex.zh: 他蒐集舊的航海地圖。

ex.en: A nautical mile is longer than a regular mile.
ex.zh: 一海里比一般的英里長。

ex.en: Nazism caused great suffering in Europe before and during World War II.
ex.zh: 納粹主義在第二次世界大戰前後給歐洲帶來巨大的苦難。

ex.en: Students learn about the rise and fall of Nazism in history class.
ex.zh: 學生在歷史課上學習納粹主義的興起與衰亡。

ex.en: A cold wind blew on the nape of her neck.
ex.zh: 冷風吹在她的後頸上。

ex.en: He tied his hair at the nape.
ex.zh: 他把頭髮在後頸處綁起來。

ex.en: Her naivete made her easy to fool.
ex.zh: 她的天真讓她很容易被騙。

ex.en: I admire the naivete of children who believe anything is possible.
ex.zh: 我欣賞孩子們相信一切皆有可能的純真。

ex.en: The railway was nationalised after the war.
ex.zh: 鐵路在戰後被收歸國有。

ex.en: Several banks were nationalised during the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 在金融危機期間，有幾家銀行被國有化。

ex.en: She applied for naturalization after living here for ten years.
ex.zh: 她在這裡住了十年後申請入籍。

ex.en: The naturalization ceremony was held at the city hall.
ex.zh: 入籍儀式在市政廳舉行。

ex.en: The nationalization of the railways was debated for years.
ex.zh: 鐵路國有化的議題被討論了好幾年。

ex.en: Many people opposed the nationalization of the bank.
ex.zh: 許多人反對這家銀行國有化。

ex.en: Natasha is a common girl's name in Russia.
ex.zh: 娜塔莎是俄羅斯常見的女孩名字。

ex.en: Natasha invited us to her birthday party on Saturday.
ex.zh: 娜塔莎邀請我們星期六去她的生日派對。

ex.en: He is so narcissistic that he talks only about himself.
ex.zh: 他自戀到只會談論自己。

ex.en: Posting hundreds of selfies can look narcissistic to some people.
ex.zh: 發上百張自拍照在某些人看來可能很自戀。

ex.en: She left him because of his narcissistic behavior.
ex.zh: 她因為他自戀的行為而離開了他。

ex.en: He is a naturalized citizen who moved here twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 他是二十年前搬來的歸化公民。

ex.en: The naturalized plant now grows wild across the region.
ex.zh: 這種歸化植物現在在整個地區野生生長。

nahum.zh: 那鴻（舊約聖經中的先知與書卷）

ex.en: Nahum is one of the books in the Old Testament.
ex.zh: 那鴻書是舊約聖經中的一卷。

ex.en: Nahum was a prophet in the Hebrew Bible.
ex.zh: 那鴻是希伯來聖經中的一位先知。

ex.en: The child felt shy about his nakedness.
ex.zh: 那個孩子對自己赤身裸體感到害羞。

ex.en: The painting celebrates the nakedness of the human body.
ex.zh: 這幅畫呈現人體的裸露之美。

ex.en: His narcissism made it hard for him to listen to others.
ex.zh: 他的自戀讓他很難傾聽別人說話。

ex.en: Constantly posting selfies is sometimes seen as a sign of narcissism.
ex.zh: 不停發自拍照有時被視為自戀的表現。

ex.en: Naturalism in literature shows life as it really is.
ex.zh: 文學中的自然主義呈現生活的真實樣貌。

ex.en: The painter's naturalism made his landscapes look real.
ex.zh: 這位畫家的寫實自然風格讓他的風景畫栩栩如生。

ex.en: The narrowness of the road made it hard for buses to pass.
ex.zh: 這條路很窄，公車很難通過。

ex.en: The narrowness of the hallway surprised the visitors.
ex.zh: 走廊的狹窄讓訪客很驚訝。

ex.en: Don't listen to the naysayers who say it can't be done.
ex.zh: 別理會那些說做不到的唱反調的人。

ex.en: Every new idea has its naysayers.
ex.zh: 每個新點子都有人唱反調。

ex.en: I naively believed that everyone would be honest.
ex.zh: 我天真地以為每個人都會誠實。

ex.en: He naively trusted the stranger with his money.
ex.zh: 他天真地把錢交給了陌生人。

narrowing.zh: 變窄；縮小（narrow 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The road is narrowing to one lane ahead.
ex.zh: 前方道路縮減為單線車道。

ex.en: The police are narrowing the search to a small area.
ex.zh: 警方正把搜索範圍縮小到一小塊區域。

ex.en: All our hard work came to naught.
ex.zh: 我們所有的努力都化為烏有。

ex.en: Their warnings counted for naught because nobody listened.
ex.zh: 他們的警告一點用也沒有，因為沒人聽。

ex.en: Her naivety made her easy to fool.
ex.zh: 她的天真讓她很容易被騙。

ex.en: I was surprised by his naivety about money.
ex.zh: 他對金錢的天真讓我很驚訝。

nativity.zh: 耶穌誕生；聖誕馬槽場景

ex.en: Children performed a nativity play at the church.
ex.zh: 孩子們在教堂演出耶穌誕生的劇。

ex.en: We put a small nativity scene under the tree.
ex.zh: 我們在樹下擺了一組小小的耶穌誕生場景。
